name: Pinball Arcade: Medieval Madness
storyline: Medieval Madness (1997): One of the most highly acclaimed pinball machines of all time, the 'Reign of Payne' comes to life thanks to the design artistry of Brian Eddy and masterful game rules by Lyman Sheats Jr. Incorporating some wonderful humor within the game theme and overall game play, there's something for everyone with a playfield that features damsels needing to be rescued from a dragon, peasants revolting, catapults to be launched to storm a fully animated castle that quivers and shakes once the drawbridge has been lowered. Add to this trolls that pop up from under the playfield and able assists from Merlin's magic and this is one pinball fit for a king (or even a queen). 4,016 units of this table were produced.
